verdict.rationale: The API docs list only single-item endpoints (e.g., POST /events/send, POST /contacts/create) and no batch/bulk endpoints for contacts, events, or campaigns; the only 'many at once' mention is unlimited contact *storage* on pricing plans, not a bulk API operation an AI agent could invoke. Missing for 10: any documented bulk/batch API endpoint (e.g., bulk contact import, batch event send, multi-item workflow updates) or CLI/MCP command operating on multiple items in one call.
